name: The Last Guardian
description: The being who entrusted the Immortal Sun to the River Heralds to keep hidden and unused.

timeline.summary: Tishana says the Last Guardian entrusted them to keep it hidden and unused, and Kumena appeals to Kopala to break the tie.
timeline.quote: He entrusted us to keep it hidden,
